summary: All iteration-1 HALT defects are resolved: ARUP is now correctly tagged `vendor_label` and used illustratively only (inter-lab spread / non-standardization), not as the numerical authority; the Bithi 2024 ICP-MS cohort [2, cohort] (~25,000 samples, 4.2–6.7 mg/dL) is the grounding source for the reference interval; the floating Labcorp number is dropped; the CLMD threshold is reframed as 'one proposed definition' from a narrative review (DiNicolantonio [5, mechanism_review]) with explicit epistemic hedge; all inline cites resolve [N, tag] with no bare [N]; no vendor_label source grounds a numerical range as authority; all load-bearing brief content (serum-poor-marker argument, CLMD, RBC-Mg imperfect-surrogate, loading test, ionized Mg) is present with appropriate caveats. Total 96, above the 92 threshold.
